_comment: Frames whose global name is required. Everything else should be anonymous: naming a templated frame also creates a global per named child the template defines.

namedFrames.BetterTogetherPanel: registered in UISpecialFrames, which resolves the frame via _G[name] on ESC; also read back via _G[panel:GetName()..'TitleText'] in Shell/Header.lua
namedFrames.BetterTogetherScroll: UIPanelScrollFrameTemplate resolves its $parentScrollBar child by global name
namedFrames.BetterTogetherSettingsScroll: UIPanelScrollFrameTemplate resolves its $parentScrollBar child by global name
namedFrames.BetterTogetherMainTab: PanelTemplates_SelectTab/TabResize fall back to _G[name..'Left'/'Text'] for tab chrome
